claims.allowed_wording: The system layer preserved local fidelity within the preregistered margin on this controlled contour.

claims.allowed_wording: The adaptive cascade met the preregistered controlled risk-cost criterion.

limitations: Policy signals are controlled; external risk calibration is not established.
